title: Looks Cool
text: Looks Cool. This looks super cool. It is heavy. It looks expensive. But it is really poorly laid out and poorly made. The things in it just don't fit in that perfect "made for this" way. It also isn't everything you really want/need. It has only a few tools in it. For something this large, it should definitely be more complete. You could also use the container for ice. If you're looking for something decorative, this is likely perfect. If you're looking for something functional, keep looking.
